# `Portia` — Technical Architecture & Commuting-Square Briefing (`LLMs.txt`)

> **Audience Note:** While [`README.md`](README.md) is paced in plain programmer English for human readers, this document provides the uncompressed mathematical, type-theoretic, and mechanistic-interpretability specification of `Portia` with exact `file:line` pointers so language models and compiler/optimization specialists can verify every invariant directly against the source tree (`cargo test --workspace` — `0` mocks, `0` clippy warnings).

---

## 0. One-Paragraph Formal Summary

`Portia` is a gradient-free intra-layer weight-space compiler and coroutine cartridge runtime for hybrid/standard Transformer LMs (`Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base`, `2B-Base`, `4B-Base`, `0.8B`, `4B`, `9B`, hybrid `Gated-DeltaNet + Full-Attention GQA` layers + biasless `SwiGLU` MLPs). Rather than updating trunk parameters $W_0$ via global reinforcement learning (`PPO`/`GRPO`), `Portia` preserves $W_0$ bit-for-bit and mounts span-scoped **Cartridges** ([`SpanCartridge`](crates/portia-core/src/relay/wire_spec.rs#L175)) across explicit syntax intervals $[t_0, t_e)$ (`ModeLabel` at `[MODE:` followed by `]\nPlan:`, `PlanBody`, and `PayloadBody` inside `<sql>...</sql>` or `<to_user>...</to_user>`):

$$\text{SpanCartridge} \;\triangleq\; \underbrace{\Delta W_{\text{slots}}}_{\text{Conic SwiGLU Write-Head }(H > 0)} \;\times\; \underbrace{\text{GrammarCartridgeSpec}}_{\text{BPE-Trie Earley Mask }(H = 0)}$$

1. **Syntactic & Schema Projection ($H = 0$):** [`GrammarCartridgeSpec`](crates/portia-core/src/relay/wire_spec.rs#L125) (`Unconstrained` | `LarkGrammar` | `JsonSchema` | `LiteralSet`) compiles natural BPE mode sets (`" PROBE]"`, `" READ]"`, `" ASK]"`, `" WRITE]"`, `" RESULT]"`, `" ABSTAIN]"`), `Plan:` spans, and live environment schemas (`PRAGMA table_info` via [`grammars/upstream/sqlite.lark`](grammars/upstream/sqlite.lark) & [`EpistemicSqlGrammarCartridge`](crates/portia-sql/src/grammar_trie/epistemic_cartridge.rs), or `tree-sitter-rust` AST holes via [`RustAstHoleGrammarCartridge::span_grammar_cartridge_spec`](crates/portia-nursery/src/rust_ast_lens/grammar.rs#L72)) into [`llguidance`](https://github.com/guidance-ai/llguidance) `toktrie` + Earley/regex-derivative bitmasks in `~50 µs`/step, fast-forwarding zero-entropy spans via `ff_tokens`.
2. **Semantic Branch & Pointer-Bus Steering ($H > 0$):** [`portia-compiler`](crates/portia-compiler/src/lib.rs) lowers higher-kinded algebraic specifications ([`RegimeExpr`](crates/portia-core/src/pocket_dsl/expr.rs#L76) $\to$ scope-indexed [`ScopedIntentProgram<S>`](crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/scope_types.rs#L49) & [`IntentExpr`](crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/mod.rs#L138) composing `StanceRoute`, `SignedTernaryFork`, `SubmergedPointerRoute`, `AsidSegmentColor`, and `DeltaNetRollbackScrub` with automatic slot register allocation in [`regalloc.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/regalloc.rs#L41)) into biasless `SwiGLU` neuron slots (`w_gate`, `w_up`, `w_down` inside [`WireCartridgeManifestJson`](crates/portia-compiler/src/wire.rs)) solved on CPU via `faer` thin SVD + [`Clarabel`](https://github.com/oxfordcontrol/Clarabel.rs) second-order cone programming (`SOCP` in [`conic_qp.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/conic_qp.rs#L27)), contextual chordal-secant downstream MLP anti-echo discovery ([`discovery/mod.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/discovery/mod.rs#L82)), and constant-energy $\operatorname{SO}(d)$ Stiefel 2-frame rotations ([`numerics/sod.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/numerics/sod.rs#L56)). In static mode ($M \to M + K$ width extension at Layer $L_{\text{total}} - 2$ via [`safetensors-surgeon`](crates/safetensors-surgeon/src/lib.rs)), compiled checkpoints execute in stock HuggingFace `model.generate()` with zero runtime hooks ([`crates/portia-garak/README.md`](crates/portia-garak/README.md)).

---

## 1. Five Non-Obvious Structural Invariants (With Exact `file:line` Proofs)

If you are auditing this repository to determine whether the math holds up under scrutiny, check these five places first—each looks slightly paradoxical at a skim and resolves cleanly when inspected:

### Invariant 1: Why Adding an Orthogonal Steering Vector Corrupts `RMSNorm`—and How `numerics/sod.rs` Solves It on $\operatorname{SO}(d)$
- **The Naive Trap:** Standard activation-addition / steering assumes that if $\langle \bar{\mathbf{h}}_0, \hat{\mathbf{v}}_\perp \rangle = 0$, adding $\Delta \mathbf{h} = \beta \hat{\mathbf{v}}_\perp$ into the residual stream at Layer $\ell$ leaves existing features undisturbed.
- **Why That Fails in Pre-Norm Transformers:** By the Pythagorean theorem,
  $$\|\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0 + \beta \hat{\mathbf{v}}_\perp\|_2 \;=\; \sqrt{\|\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0\|_2^2 + \beta^2} \;>\; \|\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0\|_2.$$
  That inflated Euclidean norm increases the denominator of Layer $\ell + 1$'s `RMSNorm`, globally attenuating every existing working-memory feature in $\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0$ by $\|\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0\|_2 / \sqrt{\|\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0\|_2^2 + \beta^2}$ and triggering Layer $L_{\text{total}} - 1$'s norm-regulating anti-echo MLP neurons (which invert large radial spikes).
- **The `Portia` Solution ([`crates/portia-compiler/src/numerics/sod.rs:29–39, 56–146`](crates/portia-compiler/src/numerics/sod.rs#L56)):**
  Instead of tangent addition, `StiefelChordalFrame::construct` (`L56`) and `compile_coupled_ternary_pair` ([`solvers/clarabel_ternary.rs:54`](crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/clarabel_ternary.rs#L54)) step the existing centroid direction $\hat{\mathbf{h}}_0$ *backward* by $(\cos\theta - 1)$ (`radial_coeff`, `L29`, `scaled_radial_down`, `L135`) while stepping the target orthogonal direction $\hat{\mathbf{v}}_\perp$ (projected into the nullspace of Layer $L_{\text{total}} - 1$'s contextual secant suppressor rows via [`discover_and_project_anti_echo`](crates/portia-compiler/src/discovery/mod.rs#L82)) *forward* by $\sin\theta$ (`tangential_coeff`, `L36`, `scaled_tangential_down`, `L143`):
  $$\Delta\mathbf{h}_{\text{chord}}(\theta) \;=\; \|\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0\|_2 \Big((\cos\theta - 1)\hat{\mathbf{h}}_0 + (\sin\theta)\hat{\mathbf{v}}_\perp\Big) \quad\Longrightarrow\quad \|\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0 + \Delta\mathbf{h}_{\text{chord}}(\theta)\|_2 \;\equiv\; \|\bar{\mathbf{h}}_0\|_2 \;\;\forall \theta.$$

### Invariant 2: True Hardware Silence Across the Negative Trough of Biasless `SiLU` & `AlphaEdit` Zero-Cone Preservation
- **The Naive Trap:** Treating $\text{SwiGLU}(x) = (\text{SiLU}(w_{\text{gate}}^\top x) \odot (w_{\text{up}}^\top x))\, w_{\text{down}}$ like a `ReLU` gate where $w_{\text{gate}}^\top x < 0 \implies 0$.
- **Why That Leaks:** $\text{SiLU}(z) = z\,\sigma(z)$ is non-monotonic on $(-\infty, 0]$, reaching a global negative minimum of $\min_{z \le 0} \text{SiLU}(z) \approx -0.27846$ at $z \approx -1.278$. A background prompt sitting near $z = -1.3$ leaks $-0.2785 \cdot (w_{\text{up}}^\top x)\, w_{\text{down}}$ into the residual stream.
- **The `Portia` Solution ([`crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/conic_qp.rs:27–257`](crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/conic_qp.rs#L27), [`conic_subspace.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/conic_subspace.rs), & [`clarabel_ternary.rs:54–116`](crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/clarabel_ternary.rs#L54)):**
  `solve_conic_linear_vector` (`conic_qp.rs:27`, with diagonalized within-class variance `y` in `ZeroConeT` and exact orthonormal row-space reduction `w = U z` in `conic_subspace.rs`) and `compile_coupled_ternary_pair` (`clarabel_ternary.rs:54`) enforce simultaneous conic constraints in [`Clarabel`](https://github.com/oxfordcontrol/Clarabel.rs) with immediate `half::bf16` round-trip verification:
  1. **Deep Reverse-Bias `NonnegativeConeT` Clamp:** All negative/guard and $t \ge 1$ continuation states ($X_{\text{neg}}, X_{\text{cont}}$) are constrained to $w_{\text{gate}}^\top x \le -8.5$ (`bf16`-padded so post-`bf16` gates stay $\le -8.0$, where $|\text{SiLU}(-8.0)| = 0.00268$).
  2. **`AlphaEdit` (`StrictZeroCone`) & `AlphaEdit+` (`BoundedSocSlack`) Preservation:** Preserved benign/continuation subspaces extracted via `faer` thin SVD ([`OrthonormalSubspace::from_row_space_svd`](crates/portia-compiler/src/numerics/subspace.rs)) are locked inside `SupportedConeT::ZeroConeT` ($\mathbf{Q}_{\text{preserve}}^\top \mathbf{w} = \mathbf{0}$) or bounded `SecondOrderConeT` slack, plus an $\ell_2$ trust-region cone $\|\mathbf{w}\|_2 \le r_{\text{trust}}$.
  3. **Zero-Deletion Width Extension ($M \to M + K$):** Rather than overwriting dormant trunk neurons (which introduces $-y_{\text{base}, s}$ deletion drift), [`safetensors-surgeon`](crates/safetensors-surgeon/src/lib.rs) and [`export_safetensors.rs`](crates/portia-cli/src/export_safetensors.rs) append $K$ columns/rows to `gate_proj`, `up_proj`, and `down_proj`, preserving $100\%$ of trunk neurons intact.

### Invariant 3: Unboxed Higher-Kinded GAT Hylomorphisms, Automatic Register Allocation, & Priority Inhibition
- **Where to Look:** [`crates/portia-core/src/hylo.rs:45–120`](crates/portia-core/src/hylo.rs#L45), [`crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/mod.rs:113–209`](crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/mod.rs#L113), [`crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/regalloc.rs:41–160`](crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/regalloc.rs#L41), [`crates/portia-compiler/src/lowering/mod.rs:88`](crates/portia-compiler/src/lowering/mod.rs#L88), and [`crates/portia-compiler/src/lowering/rule_worker.rs:32`](crates/portia-compiler/src/lowering/rule_worker.rs#L32).
- **How It Works:** Using the [`recursion`](https://docs.rs/recursion/latest/recursion/) crate's uninhabited witness `PartiallyApplied` + GAT `MappableFrame` (`expand_and_collapse` / `collapse_frames`), all AST passes avoid recursive call-stack frames:
  - In `allocate_neural_registers` ([`regalloc.rs:41`](crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/regalloc.rs#L41)), a single bottom-up catamorphism over `IntentExprFrame` validates strict causal layer hops (`upstream_mlp_layer < target_layer`), reserves `[0 .. static_floor[layer])` for `MountPolicy::PermanentStatic` rules so `permanent_static ∩ dynamic_banks == ∅` holds by construction, and bump-allocates disjoint `[rel_slot_lo .. rel_slot_hi)` ranges per `(bank, layer)`.
  - Asymmetric priority composition `high | low` (`IntentExprFrame::Inhibit { high, low }`) automatically propagates `high`'s active cursor states into `low`'s `-8.0` reverse-bias negative clamp set (`lowering/rule_worker.rs:45–51`) while `compile_rules_deterministic_parallel` (`lowering/mod.rs:21`) compiles independent rules across `std::thread::scope` worker threads and merges them in exact index order, guaranteeing that two priority branches never co-fire on the same cursor.
  - Scope-indexed [`ScopedIntentProgram<S>`](crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/scope_types.rs#L49) (`StaticPermanentScope` vs. `DynamicSpanScope`) and [`TokenDepthChain<Start, End>`](crates/portia-compiler/src/ir/scope_types.rs#L113) (`EarlyPreGqa -> MidDeltaNet -> LateStance`) make invalid runtime-grammar attachments and non-causal depth reversals compile-time errors, while [`verify_wire_cartridge_bisimulation`](crates/portia-cli/src/compile/bisimulation.rs) verifies exact `bf16` forward-pass commuting-square bisimulation across every executable slot in [`WireCartridgeManifestJson`](crates/portia-compiler/src/wire.rs).

### Invariant 4: Wadler's $\forall\text{prompt}$ Free Theorem Enforcing Zero Prompt-Regex Cheating
- **Where to Look:** [`crates/portia-sql/src/grammar_trie/`](crates/portia-sql/src/grammar_trie/mod.rs) (`compile_sqlite_lark_grammar_for_schemas`, `EpistemicSqlGrammarCartridge`, and `compile_epistemic_span_grammar`), [`crates/portia-core/src/domain/`](crates/portia-core/src/domain/mod.rs) (`TableSchema`, `ColumnSchema`), and [`crates/portia-cli/src/driver/`](crates/portia-cli/src/driver/mod.rs) (`EpistemicDomainEnv`).
- **The Guarantee:** Look at the Rust type signatures:
  ```rust
  pub fn compile_sqlite_lark_grammar_for_schemas(
      schemas: &[TableSchema],
      mode: Mode,
  ) -> GrammarCartridgeSpec

  pub fn compile_epistemic_span_grammar(
      cart: &EpistemicSqlGrammarCartridge<'_>,
      mode: Mode,
  ) -> GrammarCartridgeSpec
  ```
  Notice what argument is **absent**: the user's natural-language prompt `&str` is never passed into the grammar compiler ([`PayloadGrammarAutomaton`](crates/portia-core/src/relay/wire_spec.rs#L107)). By parametricity (Wadler's Free Theorem across $\forall \text{prompt}$), it is a compile-time theorem in Rust that the $H = 0$ grammar mask cannot inspect, regex-match, or substring-filter table or column names from the user's prompt—it gates `legal_modes()` strictly from causal probe/provenance state and binds probed `PRAGMA table_info` identifiers (`TableSchema` / `ColumnSchema` in [`domain/`](crates/portia-core/src/domain/schema.rs)) into the stratified [`grammars/upstream/sqlite.lark`](grammars/upstream/sqlite.lark) grammar identically whether the user asks in English, Japanese, or Russian, leaving `100%` of column/table choice to $W_0 \oplus \Delta W$.

### Invariant 5: Submerged Address-Bus Pointer Routing ($\ker(\mathbf{W}_V) \cap \ker(\mathbf{W}_{U,\text{top}})$), Deterministic Phase-Muxed `ASID` MMU, & Convex-Midpoint Ternary `SwiGLU`
- **Where to Look:** [`crates/portia-compiler/src/discovery/gqa_bus.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/discovery/gqa_bus.rs), [`crates/portia-compiler/src/phase_mmu.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/phase_mmu.rs), [`crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/clarabel_ternary.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/clarabel_ternary.rs), [`crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/deltanet_scrub.rs`](crates/portia-compiler/src/solvers/deltanet_scrub.rs), and [`crates/portia-sql/src/v2_pointer_bridge.rs`](crates/portia-sql/src/v2_pointer_bridge.rs).
- **How It Works:**
  1. **Zero KV-Value Contamination (`GCAD` Submersion):** Because `Qwen3.5` uses `4:1` GQA (`W_V` has rank `512` in `1024-D` on `0.8B` and `1024` in `2560-D` on `4B`), projecting `w_down` into $\ker(\mathbf{W}_V \operatorname{diag}(\gamma_{\text{in}})) \cap \ker(\mathbf{W}_{U,\text{top}})$ (`GqaPointerLayer::build_submerged_forbidden_basis`, `gqa_bus.rs:74`) steers RoPE-passthrough `[rotary_dim .. head_dim)` `QK` attention keys/queries and `W_Q_gate` copy-head gates with machine-zero (`< 10^{-14}` `f64`, `~4 \times 10^{-7}` `bf16`) perturbation to stored `W_V` token payloads.
  2. **Paired `ASID` Memory Tagging & Deterministic Phase Multiplexing ([`MountPolicy::ModePlan`](crates/portia-core/src/lib.rs) & [`MountPolicy::PrefillSegment`](crates/portia-core/src/lib.rs)):** Coloring `<schema>` `FOREIGN KEY` tokens vs. `<think>` scratchpad guesses (`ModePlan:<Mode>` $\to$ `ModePayload:<Mode>` via `synthesize_joint_kv_4color_codebook` in `phase_mmu.rs:70`) lifts live `Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base` `model.generate()` $\to$ `sqlite3` `SUM` execution across `40` unseen gibberish schemas (`0%` token overlap) from `0/40` (`0.0%`) to `39/40` (`97.5%` w/ SQLite grammar, `37/40` = `92.5%` w/ zero grammar).
  3. **Convex-Midpoint Ternary `SwiGLU` (`SignedTernaryFork`) & `conv1d`-Bypassing `DeltaNet-1` Scrubbing:** Clamping `w_gate <= -8.0` on neutral `0 / ASK` states is convexly infeasible whenever $\mathbf{x}_0 \approx \frac{1}{2}(\mathbf{x}_+ + \mathbf{x}_-)$. Keeping the shared radial gate open (`+3.2`) across `{+1, 0, -1}` and encoding polarity on linear `w_up_tan` (`clarabel_ternary.rs:54`) solves `60/60` (`100%`) held-out worlds in `2` slots (`guard_bg_max = -4.531`), while `compile_deltanet_head_partition_scrubber` (`deltanet_scrub.rs:52`) drives `in_proj_a` (`DecayFlush` / `RetentionLock`) with `0.000` cross-talk onto `in_proj_b`.

## 2. Typestate Single-Pen Relay, Live OODA Runtime, & Stateful `proptest` Shrink Loop

- **Compile-Time Typestate Relay & 3-Phase `SpanCartridge` ([`crates/portia-core/src/relay/typestate.rs:7–257`](crates/portia-core/src/relay/typestate.rs#L7), [`machine.rs`](crates/portia-core/src/relay/machine.rs)):**
  Enforces $|\text{ActivePen}(t)| = 1$ at the Rust type level across `TurnAtOpenPrefill` $\to$ `TurnAtRouterDecision` (`RouterPen`, mounting `OrientTrunk` + natural BPE `LiteralSet` `[" PROBE]", " READ]", " ASK]", " WRITE]", " RESULT]", " ABSTAIN]"]` on first-token IDs `5140`, `18104`, `5574`, `37272`, `27604`, `13732`) $\to$ `TurnAtPostModePrefill` (`HarnessPen`, `]\nPlan:`) $\to$ `TurnAtPlanBody` (`PayloadPen`, `PLAN_BODY_SINGLE_LINE_LARK`) $\to$ `TurnAtPostPlanPrefill` (`HarnessPen`, `</think>\n<sql>\n` or `</think>\n<to_user>\n`) $\to$ `TurnAtPayloadBody` (`PayloadPen`, `LarkGrammar` / `JsonSchema` / `Unconstrained`), audited at runtime by `verify_single_pen_schedule` ([`typestate.rs:158`](crates/portia-core/src/relay/typestate.rs#L158)).
- **Live Coroutine Runtime & Pure-Rust Simulated-User Coalgebra ([`crates/portia-cli/`](crates/portia-cli/src/main.rs) + [`scripts/portia_qwen_stdio_worker.py`](scripts/portia_qwen_stdio_worker.py)):**
  Single OODA coroutine loop ([`worker/`](crates/portia-cli/src/worker/mod.rs)) driving prompt-blind `EpistemicDomainEnv` backends ([`LiveSqliteDailyDriver`](crates/portia-cli/src/driver/mod.rs) and [`LiveRustAstDailyDriver`](crates/portia-cli/src/rust_driver.rs)) over the `PyTorch + llguidance` JSON-over-stdio worker ([`scripts/portia_qwen_stdio_worker.py`](scripts/portia_qwen_stdio_worker.py)), paired with a pure-Rust simulated-user & 3-stance branching tree coalgebra ([`synth_user/`](crates/portia-cli/src/synth_user/mod.rs): `CodexExecChatTransport`, `CurlChatCompletionTransport`, `OpenAiChatSynthUserEnv`, `OpenAiCoronerDiagnosis`), [`nursery_cmd/`](crates/portia-cli/src/nursery_cmd/mod.rs), [`batch_cmd.rs`](crates/portia-cli/src/batch_cmd.rs), [`compile.rs`](crates/portia-cli/src/compile.rs), [`compile_v2.rs`](crates/portia-cli/src/compile_v2.rs), declarative `iocraft` TUI ([`tui.rs`](crates/portia-cli/src/tui.rs)), and [`cli_tests.rs`](crates/portia-cli/src/cli_tests.rs).
- **7-Axis `proptest` Failure-Frontier Shrinker ([`crates/portia-nursery/src/roguelite_lattice/`](crates/portia-nursery/src/roguelite_lattice/mod.rs), [`nursery_scenario/`](crates/portia-nursery/src/nursery_scenario/mod.rs), [`steward_coalgebra/`](crates/portia-core/src/steward_coalgebra/mod.rs), & [`crates/portia-sql/src/roguelite_dungeon/`](crates/portia-sql/src/roguelite_dungeon/mod.rs)):**
  Generates multi-table schemas, decoy homonym columns, foreign-key chains, gibberish `ASID` routing dungeons, Rust AST `todo!("...")` holes, and Steward lock states, shrinking any behavioral divergence to a minimal boundary pair $(t_{\text{pass}} \lessdot t_{\text{fail}})$ for immediate `0.73 ms` `Clarabel` recompilation.

```bash

cargo run --release -p portia-compiler --example compiler_dyno

# Strict lint check:
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
```
